Experimental/Cheaper alternatives to Land Film Pack or Supersense One Instant film?
Hi there! I'm new to film photography (although i do have many a digital camera) and i recently acquired an Automatic 210 from Polaroid! after a bit of unfortunate realization, I've realized that they don't actually manufacture pack film anymore (except for supersense, but I'm not exactly keen on spending 50 bucks for 3 exposures.)
Does anyone know of, i don't know maybe an STL file or some product i can buy that'll allow me to retrofit another size of instant film or maybe my phone onto the thing? I'm a little desperate for this thing to work (also, sorry if this is the wrong subreddit)
I'm more of an experimental photographer, so I'm open to any ideas and suggestions short of taking the camera apart.
Thanks!
